description: This source file is a shell script used for generating a structured test data repository with configurable parameters such as depth, width, and number of files. It creates a directory hierarchy, populates it with empty files and ballast data, initializes a Git repository, and manages commits for performance testing purposes.

methods.name: fill_index
methods.description: Creates a hierarchy of directories and files with specified depth, width, and number of files, and updates the Git index with empty blob hashes.
